description.value: Spirits of Mt Seymour is a liquor retailer located in Parkgate Village at the base of Mt Seymour, stocking over 400 local and global craft beers, BC VQA and imported wines, single malt scotches, and a broad range of spirits. The shop also runs a delivery service covering the North Shore, Downtown Vancouver, and Burnaby. For a cyclist finishing a ride on the Mt Seymour trails or road, it is a convenient stop to grab a cold local craft beer or a bottle of BC wine.

address.value: 120-1133 Mt Seymour Rd, North Vancouver, BC V7H 2Y4
